**The syntax index is logarithmic.** `SyntaxIndex::at` binary-searches the last entry starting at or before the offset and climbs its parents; `children_of` finds its node by binary search and walks siblings by each entry's subtree end. A tree whose starts decrease falls back to the scan. `bun nv scaling fmt/classes` is flat.

items.text: **Cache each body's indent as the printer descends** instead of `opening_of` recursing per enclosing body (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/indent.rs:192`, callers `crates/nvs-fmt/src/brace.rs:109` and `crates/nvs-fmt/src/space.rs:231`), add the `fmt/depth.nvs` ladder the gap names, and close `data/gaps/nvs-fmt/opening-of-recurses-per-enclosing-body.json`. Each level is now a logarithmic lookup, so what is left is O(depth) per line and a stack that grows with nesting. Run the ladder first: if it is flat and does not overflow, close the gap with that figure instead of the cache. Rule: the goal's base rule.
